after.title: Leonida gets GTA VI's executable running, but nothing is on screen yet
after.note: ["Hours after Cyberleek's executable appeared on Monday, Leonida's contributors began running it through the project's runtime and logging each attempt in a shared issue. On builds that stack about 25 unmerged pull requests, the retail executable now runs its own code for up to three minutes on Windows, Wine and Proton. It sets up the graphics device, gets through audio setup, builds tens of thousands of graphics pipelines and opens a window.", "That window stays blank. The current wall is a console-only call on the game's command allocators that the PC layer doesn't answer, so frames never finish. None of the boot fixes are in Leonida's main branch yet, and contributors call merging them the bottleneck.", 'Posts in Leonida\'s Discord server told the same story. Soon after the drop, one said the game won\'t be playable today, "but maybe tomorrow". Later, another said it "almost boots", with a black screen and audio that cuts off. We can\'t check that timeline, and the repo still lists input, saves and streaming as not started.', "Leonida isn't alone. XCL runs a retail game its notes identify by GTA VI's executable at 30 fps on a black screen, and TuxBox shows the same black window on Proton. All three now sit at our Exe runs stage, 25%. None has drawn a picture."]

after.title: Cyberleek's README frames the leak as a protest and asks for crypto
after.note: ["A text file said to be the README from Cyberleek's archive was shared on Reddit on Nov 23, shortly after the executable drop. We haven't seen the archive ourselves, so we can't confirm the note is genuine. Here is everything it says, in our words.", 'It casts the leaks as a fight against what it calls anti-consumer habits in games: subscriptions added to single-player titles, pricey special editions that only unlock content already in the files, and licences sold as if they were purchases. Its own summary: "The enemy is the tactic, not the game." It says players were never the target, which is why the ending and story were kept out of the leaks, and that every release since its first clip in August 2026 has cost nothing.', "Then it turns defiant. It claims months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing haven't stopped the uploads, and argues that money can't make any protection unbreakable and courts can't pull back what has already spread online.", "Next comes the money. The note says donations fund a project it won't describe until there's something to show, and that some money has already arrived and paid for the first steps. It says the skills behind the build would earn more in other, quieter work, while insisting that isn't a threat. Backers, it says, can only change how fast that project becomes its main focus, not where it goes. It promises future releases will be free whether or not anyone pays, but counts every donation and every trade of its token as a vote.",
after.analysis: 涉及权利人或平台措施；以公开原始通知为准。

after.title: Cyberleek says the missing GTA VI executable is out, hours before its own deadline
after.note: ['Cyberleek posted on Monday, Nov 23 at 15:36 CET (14:36 UTC) that the executable missing from its leaked Xbox Series build of GTA VI is now out. That is about two and a half hours before the 18:00 CET deadline the leaker had set itself. The post calls the release free and says it hands the work over to the open-source recompilation and emulation projects.', "We haven't downloaded or checked the file, and we won't link to it. When we published, no outlet had confirmed it is genuine. after.title: Re-uploads of the leading GTA VI projects are already circulating
after.note: ['Our scout ran for the first time on Saturday night. From this check the 13 rows at stage 6 are ordered by their lanes and nothing else: fewest steps short of the playable bar on speed and stability together, then the better picture, the higher frame rate and the longer session. The order today: klbf-lab, victory-fork, AnyXboxX, ztrx, VIctory-Belobug-AMD, victory-perf, omonkey, victory-amd, suri, VItoriaBr, ScarlettPort, CGBJ and VIctory. klbf-lab and victory-fork are level at 2 steps short, and klbf-lab's picture is a step better. after.title: PortWatch reports the private build omonkey taken down, hours after its developer's reported letter from Rockstar
after.note: PortWatch reports the private build omonkey taken down, hours after its developer's reported letter from Rockstar  PortWatch removed omonkey from its board at 18:19 UTC , saying on its owner's word that the private build has been taken down. Its code was never public, so there is nothing to check, and no notice or statement has been published. VGTimes reported earlier today that its developer said he had received a letter from Rockstar and stopped streaming. Its row here keeps its last reported status. With ztrx's repository and account gone since about 17:00 UTC , two builds of victory-fork's code have gone dark today with no reason published. The mark published with the estimate asks for a takedown notice that names VIctory, victory-fork or a build of it, and GitHub's list holds none, so the estimate is unchanged. Both cases will weigh in its next review. vilocity's README now gives 4 to 8 frames a second in the first room on an RTX 5080, up from 3 to 7. klbf-lab's README adds that it never publishes a build that crashed in its own tests and that its 77-minute session was stopped by choice. XCL merged 28 pull requests into its main branch with its status row unchanged.     18:13  25 Nov
after.analysis: 涉及权利人或平台措施；以公开原始通知为准。

after.title: VI-BR-PORT joins the table near the top, and ruff-lab logs 21.8 minutes without player control
after.note: VI-BR-PORT joins the table near the top, and ruff-lab logs 21.8 minutes without player control  VI-BR-PORT, a fork of victory-fork for NVIDIA cards with 8 GB, joins at stage 6. Its README, in Portuguese, reports control, the HUD and the pause menu working at 4 to 7 frames a second at 1080p on an RTX 4060 Ti, sessions of an hour without losing the graphics device, and all 25,758 of the game's shaders translating on that card, with everything in shadow black. These are its own figures and estimates from one machine. The length of those sessions places it 4th, 2 steps short of the playable bar. ruff-lab's results log now holds a session of 21.8 minutes without a crash at 3.23 frames a second on average on an 8 GB Radeon RX 6600 XT with a hard disk. It says player movement does not work yet because of a controller input problem, so it stays at stage 5. vilocity's README says its rainbow glitter is gone and every shader now translates, still at 3 to 7 frames a second. five-star-recomp's status page says boots now stay 5 to 7 minutes in the world, with the lit picture still wrong. News check: other trackers repeat that ztrx's repository and account are gone, and none gives a reason. GitHub's list holds no new notice, and neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has commented since the build leaked.     17:50  25 Nov

Half the time goes to frames of about 490 milliseconds in which the card sits idle, because the game maps every streamed texture page itself, about 850 pages in a frame that streams. Two attempts to cut that cost were taken back out, one after faces came out black or red. Its speed lane now reads from its two play sessions, 4.5 on its own RTX 4070 and 7.6 on an RTX 4090 in a pull request, and it stays 3rd. The estimate moves back by three quarters of a day, to midday on Fri 27 Nov. The best averages from sessions of play are 7.6 to 8.6 against the 20 the bar asks for, and the figures of 10 or more came from the lightest scenes. This replaces the check published for 22:00 UTC , and the estimate's note gives the next marks. Its GitHub repository no longer exists at either address, its own mirror server is down, and its chat is reported gone. Whether a takedown was involved is not known. GitHub shows a notice page for repositories removed on a copyright complaint and has published none; contributors' forks and the lead's other repository are still up. The projects ahead of it are unaffected: VIctory, XCL, TuxBox and five-star-recomp were all reachable at 23:56 UTC .     23:54  23 Nov

after.title: A new leader: VIctory loads the game world, with a black picture
after.note: A new leader: VIctory loads the game world, with a black picture  VIctory, a one-person project published today, reports the game running through its first-boot screens, intro video and menus at 30 frames a second, then loading the world in about 50 seconds. In the world the picture is black and the graphics device fails within seconds. Tested on one machine. It stays at stage 5: stage 6 needs a picture of the world and player control. Correction on Leonida: its repository was not taken down. The maintainer moved it to a GitHub organisation at about 22:10 UTC , and the old address stopped answering for a few minutes. Pull requests are being merged again. This page was redesigned at 22:33 UTC .     22:17  23 Nov

after.title: Leonida is further on than its main branch shows
after.note: Leonida is further on than its main branch shows  Leonida: pull requests that are still waiting to be merged show one contributor's build reaching the game's frame loop, with black frames and stand-in pipelines, and another working out why the first interface draw shows nothing. Leonida moves to stage 4. This page now reads Leonida's open pull requests as well as its main branch. Leonida: a pull request adds a notice that the project is moving its git hosting to its own server. The official repository was not there yet at 20:10 UTC . The main branch on GitHub has merged nothing since 18:54 UTC . five-star-recomp: rectangle lists fixed and the frame loop is now stable at 30 frames per second in two-minute runs. Frames are still black, and the project says the game is waiting in an early splash or loading state. Unverified sighting: a screen-share video shows a near-empty first screen with controller prompts, a plain green screen for a few seconds, then the game's legal notices menu. The details fit a real early boot, including Xbox prompts and the green of a movie playing with empty frames. No repository has claimed it, so no project is credited and no stage moves. XCL: no commits on its main branch since 18:11 UTC .     19:57  23 Nov
